h1: Local SEO Services for Google Maps, Local Search and AI Discovery
hero_sub: Pinzo helps local businesses, agencies and multi-location brands improve visibility from the first search to the final call, booking, direction request or store visit. We connect Google Business Profile management, website SEO, reviews, local content, authority, geo-grid tracking and AI visibility in one practical system.
primary_cta: Get a Free Local SEO Audit
answer_block: Local SEO services improve how a business appears when people search for a nearby product, service or location. A complete program covers Google Business Profile management, local keyword research, website and location-page SEO, reviews, citations, local links, technical fixes, structured data, geo-grid rank tracking, conversion measurement and visibility in emerging AI-led discovery journeys. Google says local results are mainly shaped by relevance, distance and prominence. Pinzo improves the signals a business can control, measures visibility by area and reports the actions that follow.
why_matters_body: A customer may discover a business in Google Search, compare it on Maps, read reviews, visit a service page, ask an AI assistant for a shortlist and then call or book. Weakness at any stage can send that customer to a competitor. Local SEO should connect discovery, comparison, verification and action instead of reporting rankings in isolation.
reviews_body: Reviews shape trust before a customer contacts a business. Pinzo supports review monitoring, theme analysis, response-time targets, escalation rules and human-reviewed AI reply drafts. Review requests must be ethical, feedback must not be filtered by sentiment and sensitive replies require business approval.
